headline: Univolt electric mount
title: Univolt | Electric Mount and Power Worker | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a rideable power worker in Palworld one point zero? Univolt is an Electric Pal that works Generating Electricity level three. You can ride it, and its partner skill, Swift Deity, boosts damage from you and your Pals by twenty five to forty percent when an Electric attack hits an enemy weakness. Pack it against Water Pals. Will you ride Univolt? Comment below!
description: Univolt in Palworld 1.0 is an Electric rideable Pal with Generating Electricity level three.
